en:
N-No one's said all <font_kind=yakuza_italic>that</font_kind> yet,
but... something to that effect!

I tried to make sure I wasn't coming across as
sarcastic, and I chose my words carefully...

I was just generally being more conscious of
myself in my own way!

That's great.
I'm glad you made a new girl friend.

Thank you. If I keep at it, I wonder if I'll
be able to make even more friends?

I feel the loneliness setting in already.
Don't forget me, okay?

Of course not.
You're... very important to me, Kiryu-san.

Thanks. I was just kidding, anyway.
I do hope you can get closer to more people.

I will, thank you!
I'm gonna see if I can make a hundred friends!
I'm rooting for you.
Don't overdo it though, okay?
Huh? Overdo it how?

Well, self-awareness is a good thing to have,
but you shouldn't change who you are, either.

I... don't want you to become someone whose life
is dictated by what other people think of you.

Kiryu-san... Thank you! I'm okay.
I won't let myself suffocate under it.

Good. Then that's fine.
What's most important is being true to yourself.

Kiryu-san...
Thank you for thinking about me so seriously...

No matter how many friends I make...
You'll be different. Someone special. <symbol=heart_with_outline>
I'm honored.
I'll work hard to make friends, too!
Huh? You too?

Yeah. Seeing you so happy makes me want to
try harder at the friendship thing, too.

When I thought about it, I realized I
don't have a lot of decent friends right now...

O-Oh, really...?
Then, you and I should make tons of new friends!

But no matter what, no matter how many friends
I make... you'll be different. Someone special. <symbol=heart_with_outline>

You seem a little down. Did your new friend
finally see through your fake exterior?

Th-There's nothing to be seen through!
I'm not fake to begin with!

But, there have been some weird things happening
recently...
Weird things?

Maybe I'm overthinking it,
but I feel like someone's always watching me.
Like someone's following me around at night...
Wait, you mean like a stalker?

You think that's it?
Ugh, it's such a creepy feeling...
Any ideas about who it might be?

Not really...
I'm a little scared.

Don't worry. No matter what kind of guy this is,
I'll protect you.
Kiryu-san...!

If you're scared something's going to happen,
you get in touch with me right away.
Th-Thank you so much...!
It makes me so happy to hear you say that...

I didn't know what I'd do before,
but I feel much better now!

Well, the important part is your safety.
Just be careful, okay?

Don't worry. No matter what happens,
the law will protect you!
The... law?

Yeah. I saw on TV that they're tightening
the laws surrounding stalkers.

Anyone who'd go that far will be punished
to the full extent of the law.

I-I see... But I don't know who it could be, and
I'd rather it didn't happen in the first place...
That's true... Well, just try to be careful.

Yeah. Thanks for the info.
You sure know a lot, Kiryu-san.
I just got lucky.
I'll take him down right now!
What!? Take him down!?

Yeah. Warnings have no effect on guys that
resort to cowardly tactics like stalking.

The only way to convince them to change
is with the power of your fists!

B-But, it could still be a misunderstanding,
so I probably don't need to go that far...!
R-Really? Well, if you say so...

You're a life-saver though, Kiryu-san.
You would go that far for me?
I just don't want anything to happen to you.

Your concern for me makes me so happy, Kiryu-san!
I'll try to be careful.

Um, Kiryu-san... Are you free after this?
I was thinking we could go grab a bite...

Sounds good. You're a big eater, right?
How about I treat you to something you like?
Huh!? Really? I'd feel bad, though...

Don't sweat it.
I'm actually curious to see you in action.
Yay! Eating together with Kiryu-san! <symbol=note_with_outline>
Don't get too excited.

I'll need to get ready,
so can you meet me at Theater Square?
Theater Square. Got it.

I like watching movies.
What kind of movies do you like, Kiryu-san?
I like mystery movies, myself.

Oh, I love a good mystery! You like them too,
Kiryu-san? I'm happy to hear that.

Yeah, I like seeing the payoff for all
the foreshadowing at the beginning.

Exactly! I'm always like, "Oh, so that's how they
did it!" Maybe I'll rent a DVD on my way home.

Gory horror movies are my thing. Like the ones
where they have to kill a bunch of zombies.

Oh really... I don't do well with blood,
so the horror genre is kind of hard for me...

I see...
Well, that's pretty common among women.

There are plenty of women who like gory movies,
but I just can't get into them.

Well, it's not exactly "watching," but...
I've actually been in an action movie.
Really!? Kiryu-san, are you an actor!?

Nah, I just got roped in off the street to fill
in for someone. It was nothing too big.

How cool! I used to make videos just for the fun
of it as a kid. I wanna see your movie now!
I've been going to a lot of concerts lately.

The audience feels so close to the artist in
these small venues, it's amazing!

Oh, really? I hit the karaoke bars from time to
time, but I don't see too many concerts.

Karaoke doesn't have quite the same appeal as a
concert. Want to go to one together some time?
Looking forward to it.
It's been about a year since I started.

Really? I hear a lot of girls quit jobs like
this after about a year.
You think you'll keep at it?

Yeah. I've got some stuff to figure out still,
but I don't want to up and quit.

I like talking to people, and it's nice to
meet wonderful guys like you, Kiryu-san. <symbol=note_with_outline>
You're good.
I'm from Kanagawa.

What a coincidence.
I'm from around there, too.

Wow, really!? I knew I felt a connection with you!
We're the Kanagawa Alliance now. <symbol=heart_with_outline>

Hm... I'll eat anything, but lately I've been
hooked on ramen with extra meat and veggies.

The place I've been going to offers an extra large
size... I think I'm gonna go for it next time.
Impressive. You could really finish it?

I don't look it, but I'm a big eater.
There's nothing I can't eat!

Oh really? We should go out sometime, then.
My treat.

You mean it? That'd be great! Just don't get
mad at me if I order the whole menu, okay? <symbol=heart_with_outline>

I like a quiet, intelligent man.
Men who read a lot are the best.
Have you read anything lately, Kiryu-san?
Does... manga count?

Wow, you read manga, Kiryu-san?
Not what I was expecting.
Novels, I guess?

Wow, that's exactly my idea of a quiet,
intelligent man! Color me impressed!
Good to know.
I read... the mood.
Kiryu-san...! You're so silly!
Guess I misread it this time...

I'm the kind of girl who goes all in on the
housework and stuff. Wanna make me an offer? <symbol=heart_with_outline>
I'd consider it.
Actually, I want to be in a movie!

Wow, the movies, huh?
I think you'd be good in...
I think you'd be good in a fantasy film.

Oh, that'd be cool! I've love to cast some
spells, so I'd totally audition for that!
I think you'd be good in a romance film.

But the leads in those movies always seem so
mature... I wonder if I could pull it off.
I'm sure you'd be fine.

You'd help me practice if I ever landed a role
like that, right? You could be the love interest.
Sure, no problem.
I think you'd be good in a comedy film.
Comedy? What makes you say that?

You're fun to talk to, so I think you have a
natural talent for entertaining people.

Aww, thanks.
I enjoy talking to you too, Kiryu-san.
I wanted to be a film director.
Oh really? That's unusual.

I shot some videos on my own back in school,
but making a real film is such hard work...

So at some point my dream changed from wanting
to be behind the camera to in front of it!

You really love movies, don't you?
I'd like to see those old videos of yours.

N-No way! Those were like the embodiment of
being a dumb kid. I'd die of shame.

Being a big eater. But I also change clothes like
the wind. I can try on a new outfit in 10 seconds!
Okay, you've got 10 seconds.

H-Hey, wait a sec!
I don't have anything to change into!
Hm? So I see. That's a shame.
Maybe if we weren't here, though...
N-Never mind!

Putting clothes on is one thing, but...
Nobody strips off a shirt faster than me!

Huh!? Really?
Can I have a demo of this speed stripping?
I probably shouldn't do that in here...

Aww, that's too bad.
But if we were somewhere else, you'd show me?

It wasn't much fun for me, but I got laughed at 
when I told everyone I'd almost gotten arrested...
Arrested? What happened?

I left the club one night, and a cop thought I was
a high school delinquent... I had to prove my age...

Not much you can do about that.
They only stopped you because you look so young.
Hmm... But I want to look more mature...

Look on the bright side. A lot of guys prefer
younger girls, so you probably get more requests.

Maybe you're right. <symbol=heart_with_outline>
Is that why you requested me, Kiryu-san?
Who can say?
What? Aren't you a minor!?

Oh, not you too Kiryu-san... I'm 23 years old!
I want to be a mature woman already...

Wish I knew what it was like to have your age
checked. I haven't looked young a day in my life.

Well, you do have a calm demeanor about you...
But, maybe they'd take you in for questioning!
...Who'd want that to happen?
Not at all. How do you make friends?

That's a tough question. Normally you'd just
smile and try to spark a conversation, right?

But would you ever make it past the acquaintance
stage like that? That doesn't feel like friendship.

I guess it's a question of how you even
define a "friend" to begin with.

Hmmm... Maybe you're overcomplicating things?
It's supposed to happen naturally.

Is that really how it works?
It's harder than it seems...

I play a lot of video games.
I actually bought a new console the other day!
Oh, really?

I got so excited I bought two controllers!
But then I realized I have no one to play with...

Would you like to play against me sometime?
You can be my first opponent!

Hmm, sure.
I'm game to take you on.
Really!? I can't wait! <symbol=note_with_outline>
You have a secret, Kiryu-san?
Yeah. Actually...
I used to write in to this radio show.

Huh!? You did!? I never imagined you'd
be so diligent about something.
I don't look like the type?

Hmm... I guess I could see that.
You do seem like a guy who's experienced a lot.

I'm sure you had a bunch of interesting stories
to tell them. <symbol=note_with_outline>

I've been a host before.
Not by choice, mind you.

Whoa, really?
I want to see you do a champagne call!
I'm actually your father...!

You're just the type to make a dad joke,
Kiryu-san. Very funny!

Whenever I think of tattoos, all I see are cherry
blossoms. You know, from that one old movie?

Oh, you mean that one where the magistrate reveals
his tattoo right before he exposes the villain?

That's the one! I remember wanting to tear off
my clothes and resolve a crisis after I saw it!
Tear off your clothes... and resolve a...

Oh, Kiryu-san.
Did your mind just go straight into the gutter?
N-No, it's not that...
You can't fool me. <symbol=heart_with_outline>

I like drinking, but I always get flushed really
quick. I turn beet red from just a drop! It's sad!

The news seems to talk about them all the time.
Something about a war... I don't wanna get shot...

She was a really cute idol.
I've sung her songs in karaoke.
Oh, did you?

A lot of bands have been getting back together,
so I wonder if Haruka-chan will come back, too.

The adventures of Kiryu-san?
I bet this is going to be an amazing journey!
Thinking back on it, I took down a tiger once...

What!? A tiger!? That's so amazing,
I don't even know what to say...
One time I fought a hundred yakuza by myself.

A-A hundred? By yourself!?
I'm amazed you even survived...!
I was a taxi driver for a little while.

Wow, you were?
But does that really qualify as an adventure?
And... I became the fastest man in Fukuoka.

Huh? I-In a taxi? What do you mean?
More details, please!

I make a lot of sweets.
I'm thinking I'll make a cherry pie next.
Wow, that sounds good.

If you keep requesting me,
I'll make one for you.
Guess I don't have much choice.

I don't actually know my blood type...
So, I can't use it for compatibility tests...

No comment!
I'll leave it up to your imagination. <symbol=note_with_outline>
Nope, no boyfriend.
